name: 17 — Scenario "frozen-storage" (v1 → v2, content-rewrite during migrate, 2-node)
description:
2-node per-context migration for a `FrozenStorage`-typed field — a content-addressed immutable store keyed by the SHA256 of the value. v1 freezes a document and records its hash internally (`get_last_doc` fetches it back, so no raw hash crosses a workflow variable). v2 carries the store THROUGH the migrate AND performs a real content-rewrite: it freezes a NEW document derived from the carried title.
Two discriminating assertions: 1. Carry-through — `get_last_doc` returns the original payload on BOTH nodes
   after migration (the v1 content-addressed entry round-trips).
2. Build-during-migrate — `get_migration_doc` returns the derived content on
   BOTH nodes. The derived content is a pure function of carried state, so
   every node freezes it under an identical hash; the new entry converges with
   no identity stamp even though migrate emits no sync delta.

Per-context upgrade on the subgroup (cascade=false).
comment: Migrated from this file's v1 workflow by `merobox cloud port`.
Each of the original scenario's nodes is an account here; see merobox/cloud_v2/port.py for the mapping.
delete_context (unknown) x1: checks what the dropped steps did
